title: Evaluating Podcast Recommendations with Profile-Aware LLM-as-a-Judge

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing episode-level (pointwise) LLM alignment decisions against human relevance labels via a confusion matrix to identify the rate of false positives (positively skewed responses).
Comparing model-level (pairwise) LLM preferences against human annotations to measure the discrepancy in the frequency of 'tie' verdicts, showing the LLM's reluctance to output neutral decisions.
